body.p: Hunter Khanty. In another town, also near the river, Khanty once lived. One day a Khanty, also a tough guy, said to his buddy: "Let's go hunting together, I have a hunting lodge in the forest." And indeed, they pulled their little sledges behind them. Then they came to the hunting lodge. Various sables are shot there so that they are constantly hunting together. Spring is finally here, it's time for spring. The thaw is coming soon, the Khanty said again, the animal Khanty said, "Tomorrow we go, we have to get ready, now we will hunt one more day." Then his buddy was out hunting somewhere. His friend came home. The day after next, it turned out that his friend was dead. And what can you do, he buried his friend somewhere, he took all the skins of his friend's animals for himself, he came to the town and said: "My poor friend got very sick in winter, he didn't even hunt anymore", - he said, - "where to take him, I had to bury him", - he said, - "and now I'm going hunting all winter long. I'm coming." So much for summer, it's already fall again. He went hunting again and took another friend with him. He kills all types of sables. He is always hunting. One day the time of spring came, it was time to go. Before he left, he said to his friend again: "Let's hunt one more day today, one more day. We're going tomorrow, we'll pack up our things in the evening." The next day he killed his friend again. He took the skins of his friend's animals for himself, the skins of the sables, the skins of the squirrels - he took them all for himself. He goes off again. Then he came back to his town, he said: "My poor friend, we have just arrived, something has happened to him, he has fallen ill, my friend has died. I had to bury him." And he brought a large sack of animal skins. The Khanty said to each other and thought: "We have a wise friend in our city, a very wise friend. The next time he goes hunting, he should go with him. When he asked this comrade, he said, "Okay, I'll go." Fall is here again. This wise man said to the Khanty man, "There are no animals on my side," he said, "I will have to go hunting with you now." The other one, of course, said with pleasure: "Sure, come on, let's go, get ready later." The snow was falling, they packed things and food onto the sledge. They set off. He came to the hunting lodge, and sure enough, the graves of his comrades can be seen nearby. So they hunt, his friend does nothing, he also kills all kinds of animals, sable white, shoots all kinds of animals with a bow, it was in the time of bows. He shoots them with a bow. One day his friend said: "You're going hunting today and I'm packing my things. And in the evening, shortly after dark, you come back. The clever Khanty went there and came back from not far away. He hid behind a tree and approached him. His friend went outside with an axe. And there was a small birch tree nearby. He split this birch tree in two. He's started chopping it up and he's watching it. Here it is cut off like the edge of a knife, both sides are cut off. While he was cutting the neck [two halves of birch] after it was finished, he tried it on. He ties the two ends together. Like a knife blade, he encircled them both like a pair of scissors. Fits the neck well. He took what he made home with him. Then [this comrade] came, he must have had a sack, it was light at home, he was packing his things. And so they both lay down. They lay down and the old man thought: "When the old man falls asleep, I want to look at this stick". So the predators [Khanty] do not sleep for long when they lie down. And he listens: "When will the old man sleep?" Again he sighs, again the old man shakes his head from time to time. He turns back to the other side. Finally, it began to dawn. The beast-killing Khanty snorted. Slowly these hewn sticks were pulled out, slowly introduced around the necks of the animals and sharply joined together. The formerly snoring old man no longer makes a sound. There he kills him. Then he went to his city, he did not even bury him, even his animal skins, he carried away. He came back to his town and told his comrades: "This is how he killed our comrades - he strangled them with a split stick after they had fallen asleep. There is no trace of it. That's how he killed our comrades. He always said: "If we get there, my buddies will get very sick. [And indeed] his friends are out hunting all winter, and before he leaves, he kills his friends, slaughters them, as it turns out. And now, that night before I left, he almost killed me. And now I'm the one who killed him, not him me." End.
